fields.name: meshId
fields.label: API Mesh ID
fields.description: API Mesh identifier used to build the GraphQL endpoint.

fields.name: graphqlEndpoint
fields.label: GraphQL Endpoint
fields.description: API Mesh GraphQL URL (server-side). Browser uses GraphQL Proxy Endpoint instead.

fields.name: graphqlProxyEndpoint
fields.label: GraphQL Proxy Endpoint
fields.description: App Builder proxy for browser requests (CORS-safe). Used automatically when GraphQL Endpoint is API Mesh.

fields.name: graphqlApiKey
fields.label: GraphQL API Key
fields.description: Optional x-api-key header for API Mesh requests. Must be listed in API Mesh CORS allowedHeaders (see config/api-mesh-cors.example.json).

fields.name: minPrice
fields.label: Default Min Price
fields.description: Optional initial minimum price filter sent to Venia GraphQL (price.from).

fields.name: maxPrice
fields.label: Default Max Price
fields.description: Optional initial maximum price filter sent to Venia GraphQL (price.to).

fields.name: categoryId
fields.label: Category ID
fields.description: Optional Venia category ID scope (category_id.eq) for the product listing and filter aggregations.

fields.name: mockApiEndpoint
fields.label: Mock API Endpoint
fields.description: Same-origin mock JSON used on localhost when GraphQL is unavailable.

fields.name: productDetailPageUrl
fields.label: Product Detail Page
fields.description: Page opened when a product card is clicked. The product SKU is appended as a ?sku= query parameter in a new browser tab.
